gate_i1.definition: every timestamp on the 15-minute grid, strictly increasing, no duplicates

gate_i2.definition: low <= min(open, close), high >= max(open, close), high >= low, every price > 0

gate_i3.definition: no |log(close/prev_close)| WITHIN a session above 0.15 unless documented

gate_i5.definition: no |log(open/prev_close)| ACROSS a session boundary above 0.25 unless documented -- unadjusted intraday data shows a split as exactly this

session_shape_REPORTED_NOT_GATED.note: a short session is a calendar fact, not a data defect (D192): reported so a reader can see it

documented_moves.GDXJ|2020-03-19: March 2020, junior gold miners. The 15:45 bar falls 30.53 -> 25.79 and the next session opens 28.57, which looks like a print until it is checked against the daily cache: daily 2020-03-19 is o 25.07 h 31.81 l 24.05 c 25.82 -- matching the intraday close to 3 cents -- and daily 2020-03-20 opens 28.57, matching exactly. Split coefficient 1.0, so no corporate action. Two independent series agree bar for bar; the move is REAL.
